What is Alli AI?

Technical SEO automation platform that deploys on-page changes directly to a live site via a JavaScript snippet or CMS integration - editing titles, meta descriptions, headings, schema and internal links at scale without developer involvement.

Best for

Deploying technical and on-page SEO changes at scale without developer involvement.

Main features

  • Sitewide on-page optimisation rules applied in bulk
  • live deployment via a JavaScript snippet, WordPress plugin or API without touching source code
  • automatic title tag, meta description and heading rewriting
  • schema markup generation and deployment
  • internal linking automation based on topical relevance
  • site crawl and technical audit with prioritised fixes
  • A/B testing of SEO changes
  • white-label reporting and client management for agencies
  • bulk CSV editing.

Practical use cases

  • Rewriting 5,000 product page titles to a template without a developer ticket
  • deploying schema markup sitewide in an afternoon
  • automating internal linking across a large content library
  • A/B testing whether a title change actually improves clicks
  • agency-managing SEO changes across 30 client sites.

Who is it for?

  • SEO agencies managing many client sites, in-house SEO teams without developer resource, and e-commerce sites with thousands of pages.

Pricing, free access & limits

Subscription by sites, pages and seats; agency tiers

Plans described in the source

Business around $299/mo ($249 annually) covering a limited number of sites and pages with core automation. Agency around $599/mo ($499 annually) with more sites, white-labelling and client management. Enterprise around $1,199+/mo ($999 annually) for high page counts and unlimited sites. Annual billing roughly 15-20% cheaper. Alli AI is priced well above typical SEO tools because it replaces developer time rather than adding analysis.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Yes - a 10-day free trial is typically offered.

Usage limits to consider

Limited by number of sites, total pages crawled and optimised, and team seats per tier. Large e-commerce catalogues push you toward the higher tiers quickly.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The deploy-without-developers capability is the whole point and genuinely unique in this group - it turns SEO recommendations into shipped changes, which is where most SEO programmes fail
  • the JavaScript snippet works on any platform
  • internal linking automation at scale is very hard to do manually
  • white-labelling makes it viable as an agency product.

Limitations to consider

  • The JavaScript deployment method means changes are client-side rendered, which carries genuine risk if search engines fail to render them - server-side or CMS integration is safer but not always available
  • expensive at $299/mo entry
  • requires real SEO knowledge to configure safely, since bad rules deploy sitewide instantly
  • no content optimisation or strategy features
  • smaller company with less market presence than Surfer or Semrush.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web dashboard
  • JavaScript snippet
  • WordPress, Shopify and other CMS plugins
  • API

Languages

  • Works on sites in any language, though optimisation suggestions are strongest in English

API access

Yes - Alli AI API for programmatic deployment

Integrations and exports

  • WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, Drupal, Magento, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, any site via JavaScript snippet

Evaluation notes

Verify that deployed changes are actually being indexed - use Google Search Console's URL inspection on live pages after deployment, because JavaScript-injected SEO changes are not always rendered and counted. Test rules on a small page subset before sitewide deployment.
